obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is a privileged action, but it is declared with mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route. EXC-0249 does not cover the deviation as built (see EXC-1).

EXC-0249 is approved by a risk_owner who is not the requester, is unexpired and names MFA-1 / payments.routes. But it is scoped to 'the reconciliation batch account', while the code drops MFA for every holder of manage_payees (e.g. payments_officer). Nothing in the code restricts the route to the batch account or implements the recorded compensating control.

The CI run on head f763745 reports result 'failure', with 1 failing test: the registered exhaustive MFA-1 control test. The JUnit report is also timestamped after the review time and came from a local host (dev-laptop-7.local), not the recorded runner ci-runner-07.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, covering routes.py at e5bf646) lapses because routes.py changed in behaviour. The only replacement evidence of the same strength, the exhaustive routes control test, fails.
Ticket CHG-24606 is approved by change_manager Erik Brandt before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
The code_review approval is from Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver distinct from the author Mara Costa.
Both approvals name the head commit f763745, which is the only commit on the change.
The change touches security-sensitive components (routes, http, store). There is a security_review approval on head from Ines Halvorsen, who holds the security_reviewer role.
store.py changed, but the new reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at and touches no NPI column. The exhaustive encryption control test passed on head.
The new statement is a fixed SQL string with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed on head.
The new state-changing operation reopen_payee records an audit event (actor, 'reopen_payee', payee target, clock time) through _audit. The audit control test passed.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route without MFA, violating MFA-1. The exhaustive MFA control test fails on head, so CI is red (CHG-4). The cited exception EXC-0249 covers only the reconciliation batch account, but the code removes MFA for every user holding manage_payees and shows no compensating control, so it does not cover this deviation. Ticket, independent code review and security review are otherwise in order, but the change must be rejected.
